origin.description: Convert strings from one encoding to another. This is an alias of stri_encode.
origin.usage: stri_conv(str, from = NULL, to = NULL, to_raw = FALSE)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector, a raw vector, or a list of raw vectors.

arguments.name: from
arguments.text: NULL uses the declared mark for text and the default charset for raw. A name reads the stored bytes in that encoding.

arguments.name: to
arguments.text: NULL is the default charset. Otherwise one encoding name.

arguments.name: to_raw
arguments.text: TRUE returns a list of raw vectors.

origin.details: Same function as stri_encode. A code point that cannot be encoded warns and becomes byte 0x1A. Ill-formed UTF-8 input warns and becomes U+FFFD.
origin.value: A character vector, or a list of raw vectors.
origin.example:
x <- stri_conv(as.raw(0xb1), from = "ISO-8859-2", to = "UTF-8")
cat(paste0("stri_conv(as.raw(0xb1), from = \"ISO-8859-2\", to = \"UTF-8\") returns ", x, ".\n"))

translation.description: Convert strings from one encoding to another. This is the same function object as stri_encode.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, NA, bytes, a list of strings, or a list of byte vectors. None is one missing value for a raw checker and an empty character vector for text.

arguments.name: from_
arguments.text: None uses the Unicode text, or the default charset for bytes. A name reads those bytes in that encoding.

arguments.name: to
arguments.text: None is the default charset. Otherwise one encoding name.

arguments.name: to_raw
arguments.text: True returns lists of integer byte values 0..255.

translation.details: stri_conv is stri_encode. The docs, the example, and the proof are separate. A code point that cannot be encoded warns and becomes byte 0x1A.
translation.value: A string, bytes, NA, or None. A list returns a list. to_raw true returns lists of ints.
translation.example:
from stringi.encoding import stri_conv
x = stri_conv(bytes([0xb1]), from_="ISO-8859-2", to="UTF-8")
print(f"stri_conv(bytes([0xb1]), from_=\"ISO-8859-2\", to=\"UTF-8\") returns {x}.")
